title: Nicki Minaj Tried To Violate Ray J On IG Live [Watch]
htmlContent:
In an Instagram Live discussion between Nicki Minaj and Ray J, they talked about an unexpected subject that caught the attention of fans. Nicki brought up the idea of an 'undercover community', to which Ray J responded with transparency about his advocacy efforts for the LGBTQIA+ community. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FlcqKDWQ3UE Ray J, who is well-known for his entrepreneurial ventures, responded with clarity and conviction, saying: If you are rolling undercover, right? You don't need to because the opportunities are endless if the truth can set you free." He then referenced his new project, the “Gaygency,” an agency dedicated to LGBTQIA+ talent. “That’s why I'm an advocate... I’m working with Roddy Everywhere and Dumping D on that project,” Ray J explained. Additionally, he mentioned another show under his Tronix Network, called 'Girls Club', which highlights transgender experiences and stories.   Nicki teasingly inquired about Ray J's involvement.
"Oh, so that's what you've been doing? You've been trying to interact with me to promote your shows?" Ray J clarified, saying, “No, you were talking about gayness, so I had to tell you that I got a full-on network that supports that. That's all I was saying... I didn’t mean to promote anything, I'm so sorry.”
The exchange took a lighthearted turn when Nicki, in her signature playful style, asked, 'Are you coming out of the closet?' to which Ray J responded, “I can't—if there's nothing in the closet, I can't come out with it. But shout out to the Gaygency.” Ray J explained that the Gaygency is an agency that is fully operational and represents and promotes LGBTIA+ talent, with a goal to support and elevate the voices of the community. We've been in business for about two years, he shared, emphasizing his commitment to creating space for diverse talent in the entertainment industry. Ray J acknowledged that he doesn't personally identify as part of the LGBTQIA+ community, but he underlined the significance of allyship and support. Ray J's continued advocacy was brought to light during the conversation, as he is dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment in entertainment, specifically through his network, Tronix Network. Both Ray J and Nicki's conversation highlighted the significance of open dialogue, and Ray J's advocacy initiatives certainly piqued fans' curiosity about the future impact of the Gaygency and his broader initiatives.
